_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE technology-readiness-level valuation -- a deep-tech hardware startup with a component/subsystem validated in a relevant environment (TRL 5) climbing to a system prototype demonstrated in an operational environment (TRL 7), and on to full commercial deployment (TRL 9). commercial_value is the DCF/NPV value of the business assumed fully commercial (e.g. from finmodel.dcf or finmodel.startup_model); every probability_of_advancing, capital_required, and required_irr is this company's OWN assumption (gate-review track record / investor-stated required return) -- this module refuses to fabricate a universal TRL-to-probability table (see finmodel/trl_valuation.py's module docstring for why, and the real, cited evidence -- GAO's 2005 review of 54 DoD programs -- for why the TRL 5-to-7 gap specifically is where a lot of technical risk gets priced out).
